verdict.rationale: A virtual mailbox service could plausibly offer AI-generated insights from scanned mail, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions. What it does show (rule-based automation, manual tagging, Zapier and a gated API) is adjacent functionality and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
